description: Converting an object without an optional attribute with convert is an error
notes: The README says the convert function populates missing optional attributes with null values, and the spec's conversion rules populate any missing attribute with null (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions). hashicorp/hcl's typeexpr.ConvertFunc (ext/typeexpr/type_type.go) computes its result type by converting the value, which gives an object type without optional attributes, and go-cty passes that type to its implementation (Function.Call in cty/function/function.go), which converts to it and finds the attribute missing.
